summary: The preprint text covers the LC-HRMS settings and the strain and plasmid layout. The published version of the same paper (PMC11983340) fills in the Golden Gate reaction, the CRISPR transformation mix and the culture conditions. What remains is the starting inoculum, the gRNA and homology-arm sequences, and a conflict over xylose in the medium. These can be handled with defensible assumptions, and none of them changes what is measured (4-DG and MG peak areas across SC.L2, SC.L3, SC.L6 and SC.L26). I could not retrieve refs 29 and 30 themselves, because the publisher pages timed out or were blocked.

gaps.detail: Strain and plasmid identities (Tables 1 and 2 are images in the preprint)
gaps.why_needed: Defines the genotypes of SC.L2, L3, L6 and L26, plus the vectors, promoters and terminators used to build them.
gaps.resolution: Parent is CEN.PK2 (MATa ura3-52 trp1-289 leu2-3112 his3Δ1 MAL2-8c SUC2, from EUROSCARF). SC.L1 is CEN.PK2 tal1Δ. SC.L2 is SC.L1 with XYL1-XYL2-XYL3 at HIS3 (PTDH3-XYL1-TTDH1, PPGK1-XYL2-TCYC1, PTEF2-XYL3-TSSA1). SC.L3 is SC.L2 with np.mysA (PTDH3/TTDH1) and np.mysB (PPGK1/TPGK1) at the 308 locus. SC.L6 is SC.L3 with a second copy of mysB (PTDH3) and mysA (PPGK1) at NQM1, which disrupts it. SC.L26 is SC.L6 with np.mysC (PTDH3-TTDH1) at the YP locus (YPRCd15c). The vectors are the 2µ URA3 link-021/022/024/027 plasmids and pCRCT-TAL1/HIS3/308a/YP/NQM1.

gaps.detail: Golden Gate assembly conditions (NEBridge BsaI-HF v2 kit; the preprint gives no volumes or cycling)
gaps.why_needed: Needed to build the expression and integration constructs.
gaps.resolution: 20 µL reaction: 1 µL BsaI-HF v2, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase, 2 µL T4 ligase buffer, and DNA at a vector:insert molar ratio of 1:2. Run 30 cycles of 5 min at 37 °C then 5 min at 16 °C. Transform into E. coli DH5α, miniprep, and verify by Sanger sequencing.

gaps.detail: CRISPR-Cas9 yeast transformation procedure (deferred to refs 29 and 30)
gaps.why_needed: Needed to make the tal1Δ and nqm1 knockouts and the xyl1-3 and mysA-C knock-ins.
gaps.resolution: Inserts with homology arms are PCR-linearized from the assembled plasmids. Competent cells come from a 5-10 mL expansion culture at OD600 0.5-0.8. Transform with a 360 µL mix: 250 µL 50% PEG3350, 36 µL 1 M LiAc, 10 µL 2 mg/mL salmon-sperm ssDNA, 250 ng pCRCT and 2000 ng insert fragment. Incubate at 42 °C for 40 min. Select on uracil-dropout plates, then verify by colony PCR and Sanger sequencing.

gaps.detail: Culture volume, vessel, temperature, shaking and medium composition
gaps.why_needed: Defines growth conditions for the 48 h fermentation before extraction.
gaps.resolution: 100 mL SC-Ura in 250 mL Erlenmeyer flasks at 30 °C and 200 rpm for 48 h. Medium: 1.7 g/L YNB, 1.4 g/L amino acid supplement mix (-His -Trp -Leu -Ura), 5 g/L ammonium sulfate, 380 mg/L Leu, 76 mg/L Trp, 76 mg/L His.

gaps.detail: Carbon source: the preprint lists 12 g/L glucose plus 8 g/L xylose, but the published version lists only 2% glucose
gaps.why_needed: Xylose feeds the pentose phosphate pathway via XYL1-3 and raises S7P. Omitting it could change 4-DG and MG output, especially in SC.L2.
gaps.resolution: Use the preprint medium (SC-Ura with 12 g/L glucose and 8 g/L xylose), because the engineered strains were designed around xylose use. Flag the discrepancy with the published 2% glucose medium.

gaps.why_needed: Sets the initial cell density for the 48 h culture. It is not stated in the preprint or the published version.
gaps.resolution: Inoculate from an overnight SC-Ura pre-culture to a start OD600 of about 0.1 for every strain, identical across strains. The 48 h endpoint and the within-experiment comparison make the exact value non-critical.

gaps.detail: gRNA/protospacer sequences, homology-arm lengths and exact 308 and YP locus coordinates for the pCRCT constructs
gaps.why_needed: Needed to rebuild the strains from CEN.PK2. They are not in the main text; the preprint may place them in supplementary tables.
gaps.resolution: Design 20-nt gRNAs against TAL1, NQM1, HIS3, the 308a site and YPRCd15c, with about 40-500 bp homology arms. The expected genotypes are fully defined in Table 2, so functionally equivalent strains are acceptable. Alternatively, request the strains or the supplement from the authors.
gaps.source: standard practice (pCRCT design per refs 29 and 30; not retrieved)

gaps.detail: Sample dilution, vial and quantification of 4-DG and MG (no standards are described for these)
gaps.why_needed: Needed to compare the peaks. The preprint does not say how samples were handled between filtration and injection.
gaps.resolution: Inject 1 µL of the neat filtered supernatant. Identify peaks by EIC at m/z 188.08-189.08 for 4-DG (RT ~3.24 min) and m/z 245.10-246.10 for MG (RT ~2.93 min), confirmed by MS2. Compare relative peak areas across strains, as in Fig. 2B, without absolute quantification. Use n = 3 biological replicates.

gaps.why_needed: Needed for clarifying the extract. The preprint says only 'after centrifugation'.
gaps.resolution: Freeze at -80 °C and thaw at 25 °C, twice. Centrifuge at 10000 rpm for 10 min. Filter the supernatant through a 0.22 µm membrane and store at -20 °C.

retrieved_details: From the published version (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11983340/): (1) Golden Gate, 20 µL: 1 µL BsaI-HF v2, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase, 2 µL T4 ligase buffer, vector:insert 1:2, 30 cycles of 5 min 37 °C / 5 min 16 °C, then transform into DH5α and verify by Sanger sequencing. (2) Yeast transformation: cells from 5-10 mL culture at OD600 0.5-0.8, mixed with 250 µL 50% PEG3350, 36 µL 1 M LiAc, 10 µL 2 mg/mL ssDNA, 250 ng pCRCT and 2000 ng linear insert, at 42 °C for 40 min. Select on -Ura, then colony PCR and Sanger sequencing. (3) Strains: CEN.PK2 (EUROSCARF) → SC.L1 (tal1Δ) → SC.L2 (HIS3::XYL1-3) → SC.L3 (308::mysA + mysB) → SC.L6 (NQM1::mysB + mysA) → SC.L26 (YP::mysC, PTDH3-TTDH1). Plasmids: link-021 (PTDH3/TTDH1), link-024 (PPGK1/TPGK1), link-027 (PTEF2/TSSA1), link-022 (PPGK1/TCYC1), type3 intermediates M13F-BsaI-gene-BsaI-M13R, pCRCT-TAL1/HIS3/308a/YP/NQM1 (ura3, PSNR52-gRNA-TSUP4, PTEF1-CAS9-TRPR1). (4) Culture: 100 mL SC-Ura (1.7 g/L YNB, 1.4 g/L -His/-Trp/-Leu/-Ura mix, 5 g/L ammonium sulfate, 380 mg/L Leu, 76 mg/L Trp, 76 mg/L His, 2% glucose) in a 250 mL flask at 30 °C and 200 rpm for 48 h. The preprint instead specifies 12 g/L glucose plus 8 g/L xylose. (5) Extraction: two freeze-thaw cycles (-80 °C / 25 °C), centrifuge at 10000 rpm for 10 min, filter through 0.22 µm, store at -20 °C. (6) LC-HRMS (preprint s4.7, same as published): Vanquish Flex UHPLC with a Q-Exactive Plus, HESI source, ESI+ at 3.0 kV and ESI- at -2.8 kV, capillary and heater at 350 °C, sheath/aux/sweep gas 50/15/2 AU, S-lens 50%, full scan m/z 100-800 at 70,000 resolution (AGC 3e6, max injection time 100 ms), MS2 at 17,500 resolution (isolation window 4.0 m/z, AGC 1e5, max injection time 50 ms, stepped NCE 30/40/50). HSS T3 column (2.5 µm, 100 × 2.1 mm) at 25 °C, 0.2 mL/min, 0.1% formic acid in water (A) and acetonitrile (B). Gradient: 0-5 min 1% B, 5-7 min 1-30% B, 7-9 min 30-99% B, 9-10 min 99% B, 10-10.1 min 99-1% B, 10.1-15 min 1% B. Inject 1 µL, UV at 334 nm. (7) Fig. 2 legend: EIC m/z 188.08-189.08 (4-DG, RT 3.24 min) and 245.10-246.10 (MG, RT 2.93 min), n = 3. Shinorine and porphyra-334 standards (Beijing Yiming Fuxing) at 0.1 mg/mL were used in the quantification section, not for 4-DG or MG. Refs 29 and 30 and the NEB kit manual were not fetched; the published paper's reaction details were used instead.
